title: Evaluating the safety and efficacy of zuranolone in the management of major depressive disorder and postpartum depression, with or without concurrent insomnia: a rigorous systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

answer.design_quote: Studies were selected based on the following Population, Intervention, Control, and Outcomes (PICO) criteria: randomized clinical trials with parallel groups, population aged 18–75 years diagnosed with major depressive disorder (MDD) or postpartum depression (PPD) with or without insomnia, and intervention with zuranolone for treatment compared to a control group receiving placebo.
answer.k_quote: The meta-analysis included eight RCTs that analyzed data from 2031 patients.
